not a string, or not all digits. `app/db/store.py` already has the lookup function `get_by_id`; reuse it
rather than writing a new lookup.

from app.api.handlers import handle_user_exists

def test_handle_user_exists():
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"exists": True})
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"exists": True})
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"exists": False})
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": "invalid"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handle_user_exists({"id": 1}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    assert handle_user_exists({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
    print("Tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_handle_user_exists()
EOF
